correctness.rationale: For d>=3, trace-zero bidegree-(1,1) harmonics identify H_1 with trace-zero matrices of dimension d^2-1 and global L2 inner product tr(AB*)/[d(d+1)]. U(d-1) splits into axial, off-diagonal cross and tangential sectors of dimensions 1,2(d-1),d(d-2). With Y=1-|u_1|^2~Beta(d-1,1) and E[Y^k 1_{Y<=s}]=(d-1)s^(d-1+k)/(d-1+k), the scalar restriction ratios give exactly s^(d-1)(1-2t+d^2 t^2), s^d(1+dt), s^(d+1). Direct algebra yields axial-cross=(d+1)t(dt-1)s^(d-1), the other two gaps >0, so the sole top switch is t=1/d and the tangential mode is always the bottom. Fixed-volume s=v^(1/(d-1)) gives dt->-ln(v), yielding stated limits. Independent symbolic sector-moment recomputation confirmed the identities; the original rational verifier tests 42 parameter cases, not all dimensions.
